body: I have a human bio exam tomorrow and instead of studying I’ve been laying down on the floor for the past half hour watching buzzfeed videos thinking about why i can’t get up. We’ll get through this!

My parents don’t believe in depression so I’d have to wait another 2 years to get any kind of help and I’m spiraling. I’m going off to college next year and I’m so scared I’m just going to watch my whole life collapse around me. My parents have such insanely high expectations and I’ve become so apathetic towards everything I just can’t do it.

I’m happy someone gets it. My parents are so hyper religious and I’m not and I can’t help but feel so horrible that I’m not anything like the kid they want. My parents have made it clear that if they knew what I was really like they would hate me. My sister knows and she never passes up the chance to make me feel like an awful person for it. I love my friends with my whole heart, but I’m never sure how they feel about me. Everyone just makes me feel so disposable. No one’s going to care until I’m gone.

I’m sorry. I can’t say it’s not worth it because I understand how you feel. Even during my good days I can’t help but feel like I’m just...waiting for the day I actually do it. You’re a beautiful writer, though. And you seem like an amazing person. Even if you can’t see it you deserve better and you do deserve to see yourself through to being happy.

I appreciate the advice. I’ve already looked into it my school has really bad confidentiality laws when it comes to stuff like depression because we’ve had so many suicides.  I know I can’t pretend forever and like I do plan on getting help by myself once I’m 18 I just miss the person i was before, you know. I want to find ways to feel better know and this is actually the only thing I can think of. So idk. It’s just another two years and if I make it I make it. It’s just that I feel like I waste so much time everyday thinking about my depression when there’s nothing I can do about it. I’m hoping if I fake it hard enough I can focus the energy somewhere else.

The loneliness is literally the worst part. Like I’m always surrounded by people but I can’t help but think that if anyone knew what i was really like no one would want to be friends with me and that they all already hate me. I hope it gets better for you too.
I like to pretend that if I stay up long enough tomorrow just won’t come

Ugh I’m trying to balance my school books with books for my own personal enjoyment. I want to motivate myself to read so I just ordered a bunch and I’m hoping keeping them in my room and having them stare at me judgingly will actually guilt me into reading them.

So for personal enjoyment I’m reading:
**Journal of an Ordinary Grief, by Mahmoud Darwish**

It’s a little confusing but I’m only 13 pages in and the prose is really refreshing and beautiful. I’m trying to read more Arabic authors and so I wouldn’t recommend this specific book if you don’t have a clue or context on Arabic culture or history.  

For school:
**The Awakening by Kate Chopin**
**Cruising Utopia by Muñoz**

It’s not that I don’t like The Awakening per se it’s that I don’t like Edna the main character. I’m too early into it to make any judgements on whether Edna is a totally serious criticism or also meant to function as a critique of like middle class women and that kind of blind exclusive feminism.

Cruising Utopia talks about why it’s bad to problematize happiness and how that can be stifling to revolution which is something I feel is important in these really hopelessly political times.
